text:
Ava: Need a concise asset pack for the May benchmark push: three microcards (social sizes), one slide-ready hero diagram, and a one-page PDF snapshot for SDRs. Key message: inference cost-down + latency-up. Deliver drafts by Tue EOD, final by Wed noon. Can someone own design?

Maya: I can own it. Quick questions: 1) Do we want separate visuals for technical vs. business audiences? 2) Any locked numbers or should I pull latest CSV? 3) Is there a preferred accent for sparklines vs bars?

Ava: Yes please two variants: technical (metrics-forward) and business (impact-forward). Use last published benchmark numbers (p95 250ms -> 95ms; cost per 1k tokens -33%). Accent: use Accent-3 from tokens but keep sparkline color consistent across cards.

Jon: For social sizes, prioritize LinkedIn and X feed cards plus a tall story. Specs: 1200x628, 1200x675, 1080x1920. Also include plain white background and dark mode-friendly PNGs. Add hidden UTM: utm_source=benchmark_may&utm_campaign=may_push.

Maya: Noted. I'm going to produce two copy tracks and a small set of CTAs. Planning comps by Tue 16:00 PT, final exports Wed 12:00 PT. Deliverables: SVGs, high-res PNG @2x, editable Figma page, 1-page PDF snapshot with alt text.

DesignBot: Created request ticket DB-5921. Owner=@Maya, due=2025-05-07T12:00:00Z, tags=[benchmark, microcard, sales-pdf]. Attach figma link when ready.

Sofia: Make sure copy variants are short for social: max 90 characters for LinkedIn header. Also include a variant with a metrics callout box. We need accessible color contrast and explicit alt text lines for each asset.

Maya: Draft copy options below, short and long.

Maya: Technical short: "p95 down from 250ms to 95ms — 62% faster; cost per token down 33%."

Maya: Technical long: "Inference p95 improved from 250ms to 95ms and unit costs dropped 33% — faster responses at lower operating spend."

Maya: Business short: "Faster experiences, lower inference spend — 62% speedup, 33% cost savings."

Maya: Business long: "Deliver faster user experiences while reducing inference costs by a third. See benchmark details."

Ava: Good. For CTAs include: "View benchmark" and "Estimate your savings". Jon will wire the landing page with the utm.

Jon: I'll attach the landing page URL here once live. Also confirm we want a small downloadable CSV linked from the PDF? That would help SDRs.

Ava: Yes, include a download link to the CSV in the PDF. Make the PDF single page, print-ready.

Maya: Export specs I'll follow:

```
- Microcards: 1200x628 (LinkedIn), 1200x675 (X/Twitter), 1080x1920 (Stories)
- Hero slide: 1920x1080, vector-friendly layers
- File types: SVG (editable), PNG @2x, PDF snapshot single page
- Fonts: Inter variable; fallbacks: system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto
- Color: Redwood palette, Accent-3 for sparklines
- Alt text: one succinct sentence + 2-line description for SDRs
```

DesignBot: Brand-check reminder: ensure 4.5:1 contrast for small text, 3:1 for large display copy. Token reference: /brand/colors/accent-3.

Sofia: Once Maya posts Figma comps, I'll run a 10-min review and confirm assets for export. Thanks team. :rocket:
